summary: Turkcell reports a financing bond issuance via Form 6-K. The company completed a private placement of TRY 500 million in debt securities with a 93-day maturity (September 25, 2026) bearing 40.25% annual simple interest to qualified investors in Turkey. The issuance is within the TRY 15 billion limit approved by the Capital Markets Board. No change of control, acquisition, or strategic event is involved. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
